b16ec83d4b 2023-03-02 11:17:49 -0600 Check for overflow when calculating on-disk attribute data size (#2459)
commit b16ec83d4bd79f9ffaad85de16056419f3532887
Author: Egbert Eich <eich@suse.com>
Date:   Thu Mar 2 18:17:49 2023 +0100

    Check for overflow when calculating on-disk attribute data size (#2459)

    * Remove duplicate code

    Signed-off-by: Egbert Eich <eich@suse.com>

    * Add test case for CVE-2021-37501

    Bogus sizes in this test case causes the on-disk data size
    calculation in H5O__attr_decode() to overflow so that the
    calculated size becomes 0. This causes the read to overflow
    and h5dump to segfault.
    This test case was crafted, the test file was not directly
    generated by HDF5.
    Test case from:
    https://github.com/ST4RF4LL/Something_Found/blob/main/HDF5_v1.13.0_h5dump_heap_overflow.md

diff --git a/src/H5Oattr.c b/src/H5Oattr.c
index 638686587d..e431cd2e62 100644
--- a/src/H5Oattr.c
+++ b/src/H5Oattr.c
@@ -221,10 +221,6 @@ H5O__attr_decode(H5F_t *f, H5O_t *open_oh, unsigned H5_ATTR_UNUSED mesg_flags, u
     else
         p += attr->shared->ds_size;

-    /* Get the datatype's size */
-    if (0 == (dt_size = H5T_get_size(attr->shared->dt)))
-        HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get datatype size")
-
     /* Get the datatype & dataspace sizes */
     if (0 == (dt_size = H5T_get_size(attr->shared->dt)))
         HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get datatype size")
@@ -234,6 +230,9 @@ H5O__attr_decode(H5F_t *f, H5O_t *open_oh, unsigned H5_ATTR_UNUSED mesg_flags, u

     /* Compute the size of the data */
     H5_CHECKED_ASSIGN(attr->shared->data_size, size_t, ds_size * (hsize_t)dt_size, hsize_t);
+    /* Check if multiplication has overflown */
+    if ((attr->shared->data_size / dt_size) != ds_size)
+        HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_OVERFLOW, NULL, "data size exceeds addressable range")

     /* Go get the data */
     if (attr->shared->data_size) {
   200      if (NULL == (attr->shared->ds = H5FL_CALLOC(H5S_t)))
   201          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   202
   203      /* Decode attribute's dataspace extent */
   204      if ((extent = (H5S_extent_t *)(H5O_MSG_SDSPACE->decode)(
   205               f, open_oh, ((flags & H5O_ATTR_FLAG_SPACE_SHARED) ? H5O_MSG_FLAG_SHARED : 0), ioflags,
   206               attr->shared->ds_size, p)) == NULL)
   207          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTDECODE, NULL, "can't decode attribute dataspace")
   208
   209      /* Copy the extent information to the dataspace */
   210      H5MM_memcpy(&(attr->shared->ds->extent), extent, sizeof(H5S_extent_t));
   211
   212      /* Release temporary extent information */
   213      extent = H5FL_FREE(H5S_extent_t, extent);
   214
   215      /* Default to entire dataspace being selected */
   216      if (H5S_select_all(attr->shared->ds, FALSE) < 0)
   217          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_DATASPACE, H5E_CANTSET, NULL, "unable to set all selection")
   218
   219      if (attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2)
   220          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->ds_size);
   221      else
   222          p += attr->shared->ds_size;
   223
   224      /* Get the datatype's size */
   225      if (0 == (dt_size = H5T_get_size(attr->shared->dt)))
   226          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get datatype size")
   227
   228      /* Get the datatype & dataspace sizes */
   229      if (0 == (dt_size = H5T_get_size(attr->shared->dt)))
   230          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get datatype size")
   231      if ((sds_size = H5S_GET_EXTENT_NPOINTS(attr->shared->ds)) < 0)
   232          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTGET, NULL, "unable to get dataspace size")
   233      ds_size = (hsize_t)sds_size;
   234
   235      /* Compute the size of the data */
   236      H5_CHECKED_ASSIGN(attr->shared->data_size, size_t, ds_size * (hsize_t)dt_size, hsize_t);
   237
   238      /* Go get the data */
   239      if (attr->shared->data_size) {
   240          /* Ensure that data size doesn't exceed buffer size, in case of
   241             it's being corrupted in the file */
   242          if (attr->shared->data_size > p_size)
   243              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_OVERFLOW, NULL, "data size exceeds buffer size")
   244
   245          if (NULL == (attr->shared->data = H5FL_BLK_MALLOC(attr_buf, attr->shared->data_size)))
   246              HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_RESOURCE, H5E_NOSPACE, NULL, "memory allocation failed")
   247          H5MM_memcpy(attr->shared->data, p, attr->shared->data_size);
   248      } /* end if */
   249
   250      /* Increment the reference count for this object header message in cache(compact
   251         storage) or for the object from dense storage. */
   252      attr->shared->nrefs++;
   253
   254      /* Set return value */
   255      ret_value = attr;
   256
   257  done:
   258      if (NULL == ret_value)
   259          if (attr) {
   260              /* Free any dynamically allocated items */
   261              if (attr->shared)
   262                  if (H5A__shared_free(attr) < 0)
   263                      HDONE_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTRELEASE, NULL, "can't release attribute info")
   264
   265              attr = H5FL_FREE(H5A_t, attr);
   266          } /* end if */
   267
   268      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value)
   269  } /* end H5O__attr_decode() */
   270
   271  /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
   272   NAME
   273      H5O__attr_encode
   274   PURPOSE
   275      Encode a simple attribute message
   276   USAGE
   277      herr_t H5O__attr_encode(f, p, mesg)
   278          H5F_t *f;         IN: pointer to the HDF5 file struct
   279          const uint8 *p;         IN: the raw information buffer
   280          const void *mesg;       IN: Pointer to the simple datatype struct
   281   RETURNS
   282      Non-negative on success/Negative on failure
   283   DESCRIPTION
   284          This function encodes the native memory form of the attribute
   285      message in the "raw" disk form.
   286  --------------------------------------------------------------------------*/
   287  static herr_t
   288  H5O__attr_encode(H5F_t *f, uint8_t *p, const void *mesg)
   289  {
   290      const H5A_t *attr = (const H5A_t *)mesg;
   291      size_t       name_len;        /* Attribute name length */
   292      htri_t       is_type_shared;  /* Flag to indicate that a shared datatype is used for this attribute */
   293      htri_t       is_space_shared; /* Flag to indicate that a shared dataspace is used for this attribute */
   294      unsigned     flags     = 0;   /* Attribute flags */
   295      herr_t       ret_value = SUCCEED; /* Return value */
   296
   297      FUNC_ENTER_PACKAGE
   298
   299      /* check args */
   300      HDassert(f);
   301      HDassert(p);
   302      HDassert(attr);
   303
   304      /* Check whether datatype and dataspace are shared */
   305      if ((is_type_shared = H5O_msg_is_shared(H5O_DTYPE_ID, attr->shared->dt)) < 0)
   306          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_BADMESG, FAIL, "can't determine if datatype is shared")
   307
   308      if ((is_space_shared = H5O_msg_is_shared(H5O_SDSPACE_ID, attr->shared->ds)) < 0)
   309          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_OHDR, H5E_BADMESG, FAIL, "can't determine if dataspace is shared")
   310
   311      /* Encode Version */
   312      *p++ = attr->shared->version;
   313
   314      /* Set attribute flags if version >1 */
   315      if (attr->shared->version >= H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   316          flags = (is_type_shared ? H5O_ATTR_FLAG_TYPE_SHARED : 0);
   317          flags |= (is_space_shared ? H5O_ATTR_FLAG_SPACE_SHARED : 0);
   318          *p++ = (uint8_t)flags; /* Set flags for attribute */
   319      }                          /* end if */
   320      else
   321          *p++ = 0; /* Reserved, for version <2 */
   322
   323      /*
   324       * Encode the lengths of the various parts of the attribute message. The
   325       * encoded lengths are exact but we pad each part except the data to be a
   326       * multiple of eight bytes (in the first version).
   327       */
   328      name_len = HDstrlen(attr->shared->name) + 1;
   329      UINT16ENCODE(p, name_len);
   330      UINT16ENCODE(p, attr->shared->dt_size);
   331      UINT16ENCODE(p, attr->shared->ds_size);
   332
   333      /* The character encoding for the attribute's name, in later versions */
   334      if (attr->shared->version >= H5O_ATTR_VERSION_3)
   335          *p++ = (uint8_t)attr->shared->encoding;
   336
   337      /* Write the name including null terminator */
   338      H5MM_memcpy(p, attr->shared->name, name_len);
   339      if (attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   340          /* Pad to the correct number of bytes */
   341          HDmemset(p + name_len, 0, H5O_ALIGN_OLD(name_len) - name_len);
   342          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(name_len);
   343      } /* end if */
   344      else
   345          p += name_len;
   346
   347      /* encode the attribute datatype */
   348      if ((H5O_MSG_DTYPE->encode)(f, FALSE, p, attr->shared->dt) < 0)
   349          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTENCODE, FAIL, "can't encode attribute datatype")
   350
   351      if (attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   352          HDmemset(p + attr->shared->dt_size, 0, H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->dt_size) - attr->shared->dt_size);
   353          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->dt_size);
   354      } /* end if */
   355      else
   356          p += attr->shared->dt_size;
   357
   358      /* encode the attribute dataspace */
   359      if ((H5O_MSG_SDSPACE->encode)(f, FALSE, p, &(attr->shared->ds->extent)) < 0)
   360          HGOTO_ERROR(H5E_ATTR, H5E_CANTENCODE, FAIL, "can't encode attribute dataspace")
   361
   362      if (attr->shared->version < H5O_ATTR_VERSION_2) {
   363          HDmemset(p + attr->shared->ds_size, 0, H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->ds_size) - attr->shared->ds_size);
   364          p += H5O_ALIGN_OLD(attr->shared->ds_size);
   365      } /* end if */
   366      else
   367          p += attr->shared->ds_size;
   368
   369      /* Store attribute data.  If there's no data, store 0 as fill value. */
   370      if (attr->shared->data)
   371          H5MM_memcpy(p, attr->shared->data, attr->shared->data_size);
   372      else
   373          HDmemset(p, 0, attr->shared->data_size);
   374
   375  done:
   376      FUNC_LEAVE_NOAPI(ret_value);
   377  } /* end H5O__attr_encode() */
   378
   379  /*--------------------------------------------------------------------------
   380   NAME
